newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-INTER'S CARBONE SET FOR SHEFFIELD WEDNESDAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INTER'S CARBONE SET FOR SHEFFIELD WEDNESDAY.

text.p: Inter striker Benito Carbone is set to join English Premier League club Sheffield Wednesday, the Italian news agency ANSA reported.
The agency said Carbone's Italian Serie A club had agreed the transfer with the English club on Wednesday and a deal was expected to be signed on Thursday.
It said Carbone, a former Italy youth player, would leave for England on Thursday for medical tests. Inter were unavailable for comment.
The 25-year-old Carbone joined Inter at the start of last season from Napoli and before that Torino.

He would be the latest in a series of top Italian players leaving for England, following in the footsteps of international striker Fabrizio Ravanelli (Middlesbrough), Gianluca Vialli (Chelsea) and Roberto Di Matteo (Chelsea).
